caseName: Armand Schmoll, Inc. v. Federal Reserve Bank
caseNameFull: Armand Schmoll, Inc. v. Federal Reserve Bank of New York
attorneys: Mr. Hersey Egginton for petitioner. Messrs. Allen T. Klots, Walter S. Logan, and G. Schuyler Tarbell, Jr. for respondent. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Melvin H. Siegel filed a memorandum on behalf of the United States, as amicus curiae, urging denial of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of New York denied.
